keyFindings.description: The workflow's own on.push.paths and on.pull_request.paths do not list scripts/e2e/lib/held-port.py, so the dispatch-filter entry the PR adds at :415 never fires on a pull request that changes only that file, and the Playwright suite that serves Dispatch through it does not run. The dispatch filter also lacks packages/envoy/listenfd/**, though `go list -deps ./cmd/dispatch` now lists it and the filter's comment (:383-385) says it follows that list.

Main's playwright.config.ts let a bare `playwright test --list` evaluate with no server and no port probe (isListMode). At the head it throws unless every port is set, and through e2e/run.ts it needs DATABASE_URL and a full Dispatch build and boot. packages/dispatch/AGENTS.md:1165's manual grep check now carries that cost. A listing needs no server: let it evaluate without the harness.

No `## Contract change census`, though the PR adds refusals at process boundaries (DISPATCH_LISTEN_FD, ENVOY_LISTEN_FD, LEGION_LISTEN_FD; the Playwright config's bare-run refusal), changes daemon.Run's signature, removes cmdtest.FreeTCPPort and rig.sh's pick_port, changes await_start's arity, drops e2e-local.sh's default ports, and changes the wildcard `addr`/`address` log text to `[::]:p`.

receive() requires SO_ACCEPTCONN == 1 and passes socket.MSG_CMSG_CLOEXEC; darwin answers the option's bit (0x2), as listenfd/inspect_unix.go:50-53 says, and CPython has no MSG_CMSG_CLOEXEC there, so `exec --from` (DISPATCH_E2E_LISTEN_FROM, documented in packages/dispatch/README.md:114-117) fails on macOS. Test != 0 as Go does and set close-on-exec after receipt where the flag is missing.
